author: GeekBoyAdvance
quote:
It took these people 13 years with a budget of $2 billion to release an overhyped cuck simulator that has nothing to do with previous installments, made by a woke female dev team. Getting flowers, jewelry, doing chores all to keep the annoying ingame girlfriend happy. Jason is a sad, boring simp who is clearly there as a side character just to set up the girl boss. Prostitution is removed, your car will auto brake if you try to run over a group of “protestors”, the game runs 20-30 FPS in 2026 and is full of bugs. This is the type of game early 2000’s Rockstar with Dan Houser would have made fun of. Lucia is the type of character that GTA 5’s Trevor would have put in the bed of his truck after slapping her and tying her up. 

Don’t let the 99/100 critic reviews distract you either, they are paid reviews by Rockstar.
If you think giving it a 0/10 is review bombing then you must also agree that paying people to call your game a perfect 10/10 is exactly the same.

If this was let’s say a new Driver game, half of the people wouldn’t even have bought it. And those that would have, would have wrecked Ubisoft. Don’t let a name or a brand fool you, just because it’s “GTA or Rockstar”.
